text: The pain of discipline weighs ounces. The pain of regret weighs tons.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Suffer the pain of discipline or suffer the pain of regret.
First say to yourself what you would be; then do what you have to do.
The successful person has the habit of doing the things failures don't like to do.
It is not the mountain we conquer but ourselves.
He who would be free must first be disciplined.
Self-command is the main elegance.
A disciplined mind leads to happiness, and an undisciplined mind leads to suffering.
Motivation gets you going. Discipline keeps you growing.
The ability to discipline yourself to delay gratification is the key to success.
Talent without discipline is like an octopus on roller skates.
Through discipline comes freedom.
Do not wait: the time will never be just right. Start where you stand.
An ounce of practice is worth more than tons of preaching.
The man who chases two rabbits catches neither.
Concentrate all your thoughts on the task at hand. The sun's rays do not burn without focus.
Where focus goes, energy flows.
It is those who concentrate on but one thing at a time who advance in this world.
My success, part of it certainly, is that I have focused in on a few things.
That's been one of my mantras — focus and simplicity.
I don't care how much power, brilliance or energy you have, if you don't harness it and focus it on a specific target, you're never going to accomplish as much as your potential allows.
Clarity is power. The more clear you are about what you want, the more your brain knows how to get there.
The key to success is to focus on goals, not obstacles.
Lack of direction, not lack of time, is the problem. We all have twenty-four hour days.
Most of what we say and do is not essential. If you can eliminate it, you'll have more time and tranquillity.
Give whatever you are doing and whoever you are with the gift of your attention.
Focusing is about saying no.
Energy is the essence of life. Every day you decide how you're going to use it.
The main thing is to keep the main thing the main thing.
You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
The obstacle is the way.
Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.
He suffers more than necessary, who suffers before it is necessary.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
Man is not worried by real problems so much as by his imagined anxieties about real problems.
Do not indulge in expectations. Fear or desire of the future squanders what is at hand.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
Loss is nothing else but change, and change is nature's delight.
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
The whole future lies in uncertainty: live immediately.
Confine yourself to the present.
The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.
Life is either a daring adventure or nothing at all.
One does not discover new lands without consenting to lose sight of the shore.
It is not the mountain we conquer, but ourselves.
Man cannot discover new oceans unless he has the courage to lose sight of the shore.
The purpose of life is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost.
Do not follow where the path may lead. Go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
A ship in harbour is safe, but that is not what ships are built for.
The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things you didn't do than by the ones you did.
The more I practice, the luckier I get.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
Amateurs practice until they get it right. Professionals practice until they can't get it wrong.
A work of art is never finished, only abandoned.
The quality of a person's life is in direct proportion to their commitment to excellence.
Do the work. The rest will take care of itself.
Whatever is worth doing at all is worth doing well.
Mastery is not a function of genius or talent. It is a function of time and intense focus applied to a particular field.
You don't rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
The expert in anything was once a beginner.
Show up every day. Not once in a while. Every day.
Perfection is achieved not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
A small daily task, if it be really daily, will beat the labours of a spasmodic Hercules.
Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Silence is the sleep that nourishes wisdom.
Within you there is a stillness and a sanctuary to which you can retreat at any time.
The quieter you become, the more you can hear.
Nothing in all creation is so like God as stillness.
Retire into yourself as much as you can.
The present moment always will have been.
Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.
